_comment: §12 S1 real-failure fixture — banked as T3 regression corpus (AC-65.3)
description: Helius Sender /fast endpoint returned HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable) on a sell attempt. Per-attempt fallback: the same signed transaction is immediately resubmitted to the plain Helius RPC endpoint. The circuit breaker records the 5xx error. Buys do NOT use this fallback to prevent double-open.
notes: Fallback uses the same serialized signed tx — no re-signing. The nonce in the tx must still be valid (< 150 slots). On sell retries with the PANIC tier, each attempt re-signs with a fresh blockhash.
